mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the unemployment rate, indicating a rapidly weakening labor market, will trigger a risk-off sentiment that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth decelerates sharply, indicating supply chain disruptions, it will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth < 2% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly different from baseline periods during supply shock signals (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth accelerates, signaling a tightening labor market, it will boost wage growth and consumption, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Real consumption expenditures (PCE) do not accelerate in the 3 months following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth decelerates sharply, indicating a weakening housing market, it will negatively impact related sectors and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY growth < -10% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Homebuilder stocks (ITB) outperform SPX during the signal period, indicating a disconnect between the housing market and broader economy.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy, it will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower than baseline periods when FEDFUNDS > 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real consumption expenditures (PCE) growth accelerates, signaling strengthening consumer demand, it will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth > 5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Retail sector stocks (XRT) underperform SPX during the signal period, indicating a disconnect between consumer spending and equity market performance.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is low and falling, signaling a tightening labor market, but inflation (CPI) is also rising, it indicates a wage-price spiral that will negatively impact corporate profit margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Corporate profit margins (NIPA table 6.17B line 13) do not compress during the signal period, indicating that companies are able to pass on rising costs to consumers without impacting earnings.
